description: This file contains Redux action creators and utility functions for managing draft messages in the Mattermost web application, including fetching, updating, removing, and transforming drafts between server and local state.

methods.name: getDrafts
methods.description: Fetches drafts from the server for a specific team, reconciles with local drafts, and updates the global state with the latest drafts.

methods.name: removeDraft
methods.description: Removes a draft locally and from the server if synced drafts are enabled.

methods.name: updateDraft
methods.description: Updates a draft locally and optionally saves it to the server if synced drafts are enabled.

methods.name: setGlobalDraft
methods.description: Sets a draft in the global state and marks its source as remote or local.

methods.name: setGlobalDraftSource
methods.description: Marks the source of a draft as remote or local.

methods.name: transformServerDraft
methods.description: Transforms a server draft object into a local draft format.
